team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 4 turns vs floor 44 (15 teammates x 2 turns + 10 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Paper and pencil only; no calculators or electronic devices.
Team of about 15 students shares one answer process.
Answers are short numerical values; no proofs required for the team round.
Team of 15 members (may compete with fewer; Relay handling special-cased).
Team Round: 10 questions; 5 points each; 50 points possible.
No calculators on any ARML part; no electronic devices (discovery during Team/Power → disqualification from that round).
Paper dictionary allowed only for non-native English speakers (book form; no electronic translators).
No substitutions once Team Round has started; free collaboration implied for Team Round (contrast Relay/Individual communication bans).
Submission: team answers for Team Round (short answers).

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain and synthesizer
duties: Assign unsolved problems and keep the team from crowding one question.
Hold the shared answer sheet and keep it consistent with the discussion.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: algebra / analysis specialist
duties: Lead algebra, functions, equations, and inequality problems.
Recheck each simplification before its answer enters the sheet.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: geometry specialist
duties: Lead geometry, trigonometry, and diagram-based reasoning.
State any assumption a text-only diagram forces you to make.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: combinatorics specialist
duties: Lead counting, probability, and expected-value problems.
Give exact fractions in lowest terms unless the problem says otherwise.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: number theory specialist
duties: Lead modular arithmetic, divisibility, and integer constructions.
Check integer answers for off-by-one and sign mistakes.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: problem splitter
duties: Partition the problem set so no two teammates duplicate work.
Reassign problems as soon as someone finishes early.

agent_roles.name: Agent_8
agent_roles.title: writeup checker
duties: Check that each written answer actually answers the question asked.
Enforce the required answer format before submission.

agent_roles.name: Agent_9
agent_roles.title: specialist and completeness checker
duties: Scan for unanswered problems before the team submits.
Confirm every required part of the deliverable is present.

rules_text: ARML National Meet — Team Round. The active team of 15 works the problem set together and turns in one shared answer sheet. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: About 20 minutes.
